system.description:
Veteran Black Raiders will end up extensively covered in tattoos, as each milestone they reach or mission they accomplish is rewarded with further ritual markings. The high concentration of enchanted ink, infused with the blood and ichor of various creatures, will give specialised abilities to the Raider.

Only one Aspect can be chosen, depending on the type of ink earned in the highest quantity.

Every Aspect has a Passive Effect, that is always on, and an Active Effect. Using the Active Effect will cause the user to suffer 1 level of Fatigue per each time used during combat. The levels of Fatigue will only come into effect after combat ends, but they will be compounded and experienced all together as a crash.

Aberrant Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain 60ft of Telepathy.

Active Effect: Psychic Thrust. As an action, you target one creature within 30ft and send a painful pulse through their mind. The target must make an Intelligence save against your Spell DC if you’re a spellcaster, Maneuver DC if you’re not. On a fail, the target takes 4d6 damage and is [[/condition id=rattled]] until the end of its next turn. A creature that is already Rattled becomes [[/condition id=stunned]] on a failure. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn’t suffer the relevant condition effect.

Beastly Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain advantage on Perception checks based on Hearing and Smell.

Active Effect: Trample. As an action, you may move up to your speed in a straight line, trampling any creatures in your path. Each affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Maneuver DC, or take 3d10 bludgeoning damage.

If any of the creatures are reduced to 0 hit points as a result of being Trampled, you may make a melee attack, fueled by the battle’s frenzy. This attack must be within your reach when you end your Trample.

This action does not reduce your regular movement.

Draconic Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain 30ft of Blindsight and 60ft of Darkvision.

Active Effect: Dragon’s Breath. You can use your action to exhale a magical breath in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Spell DC (or Maneuver DC if you can’t cast spells), taking 4d6 damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

The type of damage is chosen upon first taking on the Aspect, based on the type of Dragon the Aspect will channel. The choice is permanent.

(Black Dragon: Acid, White Dragon: Cold, Red Dragon: Fire, Blue Dragon: Lightning, Shadow Dragon: Necrotic, Green Dragon: Poison)

Elemental Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain resistance to one damage type of choice between fire, cold, lightning and poison. The choice is permanent.

Active Effect: You can also choose to infuse any weapon you’re proficient in with a few drops of your blood. The weapon thus infused will deal 1d8 extra damage of the type you’re resistant to. You can only have one infused weapon at any time.

Fiendish Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain 60ft of Darkvision and resistance to damage from Non-magical weapons.

Active Effect: Blade’s Kiss. If you’re wielding a bladed weapon, you can channel your Aspect into the blade as a Bonus Action, before making a melee attack. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC or take 2d10 psychic damage. You will regain hit points equal to the damage the target takes. On a success, the target only takes damage from the regular hit, and you don’t regain any hit points.

Giant Aspect

Passive Effect: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity, and have advantage against being knocked prone by creatures of size Medium or smaller.

Active Effect: Sweeping Strike. When you make a melee attack that would normally target one creature, you can also target other creatures within 10ft of you, up to a maximum of 3 creatures. Any creature who gets hit by this attack is knocked back 10ft, causing 1d10 bludgeoning damage to any creature in its way. Creatures who are bowled over in such a manner must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC or fall [[/condition id=prone]].

Monstrous Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain immunity to both the [[/condition id=charmed]] and [[/condition id=frightened]] conditions.

Active Effect: Ominous Glower. As your action, you choose one creature within 60ft and channel your Aspect in your gaze. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell DC (or Maneuver DC if you can’t cast spells), or take 3d8 necrotic damage and become Frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

On a success, the target takes half damage and isn’t Frightened.

Undying Aspect

Passive Effect: You gain resistance to necrotic damage.

Active Effect: Immobilising Touch. As your action, you touch one creature within melee range. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell DC (or Maneuver DC if you can’t cast spells), or be [[/condition id=paralyzed]] for 1 minute. At the end of each of their turn, the target can repeat the save to shake off the effect.
system.prerequisite: must have taken Raider Initiate and Raider Cohort previously, must be level 8 or above
